Fist J'ehlar is a Flaming Fist who aids  Art Cullagh at Last Light Inn during Act Two. She asks the party to Wake up Art Cullagh and locate  Duke Ravengard.
“
A century locked inside a Sharran curse will do things to a man. But you're not alone, sir. We're here with you.
„
— J'ehlar, to an unconscious Art Cullagh

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Initially on a mission led by  Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard, J'ehlar and the rest of the Fists were waylaid by the dangers of the Shadow-Cursed Lands and found refuge with the Harpers at Last Light Inn. J'ehlar is initially seen sitting next to  Art Cullagh with a handful of other Flaming Fists.

If Florrick was not rescued from Waukeen's Rest in Act One, J'ehlar does not appear in the game.

Wake up Art Cullagh

If a party member interacts with Art Cullagh, J'ehlar reveals they found him shambling into Last Light Inn by himself, corrupted and wounded. Since then, despite the man's slumber, J'ehlar has been tending to his injuries in hopes that he would wake up and assist them in locating Duke Ravengard. Asking about his personal effects, J'ehlar gives the party a  Worn Letter in the hopes that it aids in waking him up.

Resolve the Abduction

When  Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, J'ehlar does not join the battle and instead remains seated next to Art Cullagh's bed, even if the battle reaches her room. If Isobel is not saved, she too turns into a  Shadow-Cursed Undead.

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn and the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, J'ehlar is among the Fists left by Florrick to follow Jaheira to Moonrise Towers. However, J'ehlar is killed during the initial fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. Her corpse is on the bridge leading to Moonrise, implying she was amongst the first to fall in battle.
